item.title: Did the committee get it WRONG?! 😠 Will the Iron Bowl even matter? 🤔 Alabama can't play SCARED!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
Alabama football legend Rashaan Evans returns to Beat Everyone to talk about the Iron Bowl, College Football Playoff rankings, the SEC Championship Game, and more! Evans reacts to Alabama's No. 6 ranking in the latest poll and tells us if the CFP is a distraction for the players as they get ready for Auburn. How hyped are Bama players for this Iron Bowl? How would Rashaan defend Byrum Brown and Auburn's offense? Should the Crimson Tide want to skip the SEC title game if it could hurt their playoff position and readiness? Rashaan takes us behind the scenes and into the locker room with his favorite Iron Bowl memories, plus his thoughts on the ESPN Nick Saban documentary!

item.title: Alabama vs. Auburn: The Iron Bowl Plays You Forgot!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
Everyone remembers the Kick Six, Bo Over the Top and 4th-and-31. But what about the moments that helped make those plays happen?
From game-saving defensive stops and costly turnovers to unlikely touchdowns, we're revisiting some of the most consequential — and often overshadowed — moments in the Alabama-Auburn rivalry.
Take a look back at these 'forgotten' Iron Bowl plays spanning more than three decades, including moments featuring Antonio Langham, James Bostic, Quentin Groves, Sammie Coates and more.
Which 'forgotten' Iron Bowl plays would you add to the list?
